author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260512T002136Z-1705809
text: Escalating to human: bead description explicitly requests human approval on the dep-graph question (option (i) — add pkix-lint as a workspace dep of pkix-profiles and pkix-profiles-cabf). All three options are non-equivalent refactors of the dep tree; the bead author already enumerated them and picked (i) as recommended. The autonomous loop should not unilaterally adopt a dep-graph reshape that the maintainer asked to confirm. Recommend: confirm option (i). Concrete impact if confirmed: pkix-profiles gains pkix-lint = { workspace = true } in [dependencies]; pkix-profiles-cabf gains pkix-lint + pkix-lint-cabf in [dependencies] (pkix-lint-cabf was added to pkix-lint-cabf-refresh and the workspace by PKIX-amgn.8.2; PKIX-amgn.5 just moved cabf_tls_br into pkix-lint-cabf 0.2.0). Both BasicTlsProfile/BasicSmimeProfile (pkix-profiles) and WebPkiProfile/SmimeProfile/CodeSigningProfile (pkix-profiles-cabf) will need impl LintProfile additions with appropriate Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> contents. The cabf-side profiles will reference pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br lints. Note: BasicTlsProfile/BasicSmimeProfile in pkix-profiles will need at least one Lint to call — currently pkix-lint ships only Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint. Bead's 'out of scope' note already says: if the Lint set would be empty, file a sub-bead for the missing lints rather than implementing them here. So even after option (i) is approved, .9.2 likely needs a sub-bead for missing RFC 6125 / serverAuth-EKU Lints in pkix-lint.
